title: Chest Transporter - Relocated!
description: Adds items that, you know... transport chests!
body:
This mod adds several Chest Transporter Items. they are used by right clicking a chest. allowing you to move your chest with goodies somewhere else without having to break it!



Assets are mine, original concept was created/popularized by cubex2.
